basic_details.job_title: Govt HSS Telgam Guest Faculty Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline
basic_details.short_information: The official notification does not specify the number of vacancies or the application fee.

qualification.education_qualification: Master's Degree in the concerned subject with at least 50% marks or equivalent grade AND a B.Ed. or equivalent degree, recognized by the NCTE, New Delhi, in the case of B.Ed. subjects.
qualification.details: Qualification: Master's Degree in the concerned subject with at least 50% marks or equivalent grade AND a B.Ed. or equivalent degree, recognized by the NCTE, New Delhi, in the case of B.Ed. subjects. Subjects: Odia, English, History, Economics, Political Science, Opt. Odia. Experience: Retired Government and Aided College / Higher Secondary School teachers are invited; fresh candidates will be selected in case of non-availability of teachers Age limit: Below 65 years | Desirable: | Basic experience in computer applications

salary_details.pay_scale: Rs. 400 per class/lecture of 45 minutes, maximum 50 classes, with Rs. 20,000 per month

how_to_apply: Apply in the prescribed format enclosed with the advertisement.
Attach self-attested copies of the documents listed in the notice.
The application should reach the Principal, Govt. Higher Secondary School, Telgam on or before 10.11.2026.
Attend document verification on 12.11.2026 from 10.00 AM in the office of the Principal.
important_instructions: Subjects offered: Odia, English, History, Economics, Political Science, Opt. Odia No TA/DA shall be admissible for document verification The Principal reserves the right to cancel part or whole of the engagement notice without assigning any reason

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for Govt HSS Telgam Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 10 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How do I apply for Govt HSS Telgam Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form (Prescribed format (biodata format) enclosed with the advertisement) and send it to The Principal, Govt. Higher Secondary School, Telgam, At-Telgam, Post: Nehura, Block: Umerkote, District: Nabarangpur, PIN - 764073, by by post or in person, to reach by 10 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for Govt HSS Telgam Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The age limit is below 65 years.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Rs. 400 per class/lecture of 45 minutes, maximum 50 classes, with Rs. 20,000 per month.

faq.question: Q5. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Master's Degree in the concerned subject with at least 50% marks or equivalent grade AND a B.Ed. or equivalent degree, recognized by the NCTE, New Delhi, in the case of B.Ed. subjects.

faq.question: Q6. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Career assessment. Teaching experience. Basic experience in computer applications. Document verification.

faq.question: Q7. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Engagement is purely temporary in nature. Continues till closure of the school for the next summer vacation of 2026-27 or posting of a PGT in the school, whichever is earlier. May be disengaged with one month's notice if performance is not satisfactory.

faq.question: Q8. Where is the posting for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Govt. Higher Secondary School, Telgam, Block Umerkote, District Nabarangpur.

faq.question: Q9. Which documents are needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: HSC or equivalent certificate and mark sheet; Bachelor Degree and Master degree or equivalent certificates and mark sheets; Certificate of computer knowledge and Experience certificate; ID proof / Address proof.

faq.question: Q10. What is the advertisement number of this recruitment?
faq.answer: It is Advt No. 01/2026.
